name: DYU • Website content
description: Editable site sections. Handles connect entries to the website. Content and images can be changed safely without editing code.

fieldDefinitions.name: Editor label
fieldDefinitions.description: Name shown in Shopify. Keep the entry handle unchanged; it identifies the site section.

fieldDefinitions.name: Eyebrow / small heading
fieldDefinitions.description: Short line above the heading.

fieldDefinitions.name: Heading
fieldDefinitions.description: Main heading. Line breaks are supported; layout stays managed by the site.

fieldDefinitions.name: Emphasized heading
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional italic part of the heading.

fieldDefinitions.name: Body text
fieldDefinitions.description: Plain text only. Leave blank to keep the site default. Use short copy for home sections; longer paragraphs for journal or information pages.

fieldDefinitions.name: Desktop / section image
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose a Shopify image. Leaving this blank uses the existing site artwork.

fieldDefinitions.name: Mobile image
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose a Shopify image. Leaving this blank uses the existing site artwork.

fieldDefinitions.name: Image description
fieldDefinitions.description: Describe the image for accessibility.

fieldDefinitions.name: Image focal position
fieldDefinitions.description: Safe crop position.

fieldDefinitions.name: Primary button text
fieldDefinitions.description: Keep labels short.

fieldDefinitions.name: Primary destination
fieldDefinitions.description: Use a local route (/shop), https URL, mailto: or tel:. Unsafe links are ignored by the site.

fieldDefinitions.name: Secondary button text
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional second button.

fieldDefinitions.name: Secondary destination
fieldDefinitions.description: Use a local route or https URL.

fieldDefinitions.name: Show this section
fieldDefinitions.description: Turn supported optional sections, including the homepage hero, off without removing their content. Essential purchase controls and core page introductions remain available.

fieldDefinitions.name: Display order
fieldDefinitions.description: Display order for carousel slides, navigation, FAQ, journal and repeatable entries. Homepage section order is set in Home · Section order.

fieldDefinitions.name: Selected products
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose products in display order. Native product data stays in Products.

fieldDefinitions.name: Selected collections
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose collections in display order.

fieldDefinitions.name: Short list items
fieldDefinitions.description: For bullet lists, captions, or navigation labels used by this section.

fieldDefinitions.name: Supporting note
fieldDefinitions.description: Short supporting line.

fieldDefinitions.name: Caption
fieldDefinitions.description: Short caption beneath the content.

fieldDefinitions.name: Category
fieldDefinitions.description: Journal or information category.

fieldDefinitions.name: Reading time
fieldDefinitions.description: Example: 3 MIN READ.

name: DYU • Ingredient
description: Ingredient names and optional approved descriptions. Reference these from DYU ingredients on products; existing taxonomy remains unchanged.

fieldDefinitions.name: Ingredient name
fieldDefinitions.description: Use the approved ingredient name.

fieldDefinitions.name: Description
fieldDefinitions.description: Approved ingredient description. Leave blank if not yet reviewed.

fieldDefinitions.name: Botanical name
fieldDefinitions.description: Optional verified botanical name.

fieldDefinitions.name: Ingredient image
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose a Shopify image. Leaving this blank uses the existing site artwork.

name: DYU • Making or ritual step
description: Reusable approved making and usage steps. The product list controls the order.

fieldDefinitions.name: Step name
fieldDefinitions.description: Short step heading.

fieldDefinitions.name: Instructions / description
fieldDefinitions.description: Approved instructions only. Do not infer usage or manufacture from a product name.

fieldDefinitions.name: Step image
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose a Shopify image. Leaving this blank uses the existing site artwork.
